integrity: One explicit theorem; integral primitive basis and geometric symmetry, with standalone exact arithmetic verifier.
scientific_limitations: Geometric rectangular grids and robust level three only; full indexed related-work texts not accessible, so unindexed equivalent integral bases remain possible. Finite verifier tests do not prove the infinite theorem; proof uses arbitrary-field induction and an independently established homotopy-rank theorem.
title: Primitive square-pair cycle basis for three-robust clique homology of rectangular grids
